Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect trash 1 digivolution card each from 3 of my opponent's Digimon or trash 2 digivolution cards from 1 of their Digimon and 1 digivolution card from another?
Can this card's [When Attacking] effect unsuspend this Digimon when my opponent has no Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash any 3 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon.
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If your opponent has no Digimon with as many or more digivolution cards as this Digimon, unsuspend this Digimon.
